nodes.label: ADR-001: Frontend Boundary Models and Canonical Internal Shapes
nodes.rationale: Recurring regressions from raw payload shapes leaking into internal types, multiple accepted shapes, and deep coercions are architectural constraints needing explicit rules, not one-off bug fixes.

nodes.label: Canonical Internal Shape
nodes.rationale: Each domain concept keeps one canonical internal shape; compatibility coercions happen only at fetch, decode, submit, or adapter boundaries and helpers never widen back to generic unions.

nodes.label: Transport Boundary Decoding
nodes.rationale: Transport payload types live in src/types/transport.ts and internal types in src/types/index.ts; nested backend payloads decode and encode through the main transport boundary instead of passing raw subtrees.
